limitations: The result concerns the mixed two-weight weak-L1 endpoint of the positive sparse operator for zero less than r less than one. It does not assert a matching lower bound for every operator admitting sparse domination, determine the optimal r-dependent constant, or address the distinct r equals one logarithmic endpoint. The motivating preprint is extremely recent and was not retrievable in full text during this audit.
